context: M20 o4. After the meeting. Marjorie leaves the ledger open on her desk and goes to get coffee. She looks back once.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: My name. Corwin. The Broadway hotels. The surcharge 'consultancy'. All me.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: And the first page. October 1971. 'Consideration, case 71-4402. C.M.'

lines.speaker: char.marjorie_kell
lines.text: Mr. Lisle is in conference. Mr. Lisle is always in conference.

lines.speaker: char.marjorie_kell
lines.text: I typed every word of it, Mr. Varelas. Nobody ever asks the typist.

lines.speaker: char.marjorie_kell
lines.text: Carbons. Nothing in this office happens only once. Good afternoon.
